DisplayName: Thriving in Grad School: Time and Stress Management
Title: Thriving in Grad School: Time and Stress Management
Summary: Graduate students are invited to join us for this session covering practical strategies for prioritizing tasks, creating realistic schedules and combating stress through mindfulness techniques.

Graduate school can be stressful, but with the right tools, you can manage your time and reduce stress effectively. Join us to learn practical strategies for prioritizing tasks, creating realistic schedules and combating stress through mindfulness techniques.

DisplayName: Career Pathways-The Entreprenurial Spirit: Becoming a Small Business Owner
Title: Career Pathways-The Entreprenurial Spirit: Becoming a Small Business Owner
Summary: Join us for an engaging workshop designed to empower aspiring and current small business owners with the skills, knowledge and mindset needed to thrive in the entrepreneurial world.
Details:
Join us for our first Career Pathways workshop of the fall semester, designed to empower aspiring and current small business owners with the skills, knowledge and mindset needed to thrive in the entrepreneurial world. Discover the key traits of successful entrepreneurs—curiosity, creativity, resilience, adaptability and the courage to take calculated risks—and learn how to cultivate and apply them to your business journey.

This session is perfect for:

Aspiring entrepreneurs
Startup founders
Small business owners seeking growth strategies
Anyone interested in developing an entrepreneurial mindset
Hear firsthand from UTSA alumni small business owners as they share their experiences, insights, and answer your questions.

Summary: Join the Graduate School for our Dissertation Weekend Warrior (DWW) program for STEM doctoral students.
Details: Join the Graduate School for our Dissertation Weekend Warrior (DWW) program for STEM doctoral students who are preparing to enter the dissertation phase or who are in the early stages of writing their dissertation. The DWW program prepares doctoral students through an in-person, engaged and in-depth approach led by subject-matter experts from across Roadrunner Nation. For more info, contact gps@utsa.edu.

Title: Professional and Career Development 2: Leadership 102
Summary: Part of our Professional and Career Development series, join us to learn how to improve your leadership skills.
Details:
Explore the core principles of effective leadership—integrity, transparency, inclusivity and respect—in this interactive session. Learn to distinguish between managers and leaders and discover how empowerment shapes impactful leadership.
Through guided breakout activities, participants will:
1.	Define leadership in their own words
2.	Reflect on examples of effective vs. ineffective leadership
3.	Begin crafting a personal leadership philosophy
Students who attend four out of six Professional and Career Development sessions will earn a microcredential badge.

DisplayName: Professional and Career Development 3: Leveraging Adobe to Creative Visually Stimulating Content for Scientific Publications and Beyond
Title: Professional and Career Development 3: Leveraging Adobe to Creative Visually Stimulating Content for Scientific Publications and Beyond
Summary: Training session for graduate students covering Adobe basic tools for academic success.
Details:
During this training session, grad students and postdocs will learn how to create effective posters in Adobe Illustrator. You will learn how to use basic tools, import graphs, charts and images and how to make your poster stand out during a poster presentation session. By the end of this training session, you will be able to:

-Understand the basic tools and features of Adobe Illustrator
-Layout posters with text, images, and graphics
-Increase the impact of your printed materials
-Export posters for printing or online use
